morphology.pattern_note: peN-在r前实现为pe-，保留词根r，形成pe-rinci-an；末尾i与-an相接，标准读音可分读为/i.an/。输入将perincian标为原根词，已依据DBP的rinci词族作校正。

senses.zh_definition: 将整体按较小项目分列、细分的安排或结果；逐项明细。
senses.en_definition: An itemised breakdown of a whole into smaller parts or categories.
senses.ms_definition: Pembahagian sesuatu kepada bahagian kecil atau butiran yang berasingan.
senses.nuances: 强调把总额、数据或项目拆开列示，常见于财务与统计。perincian是名词；形容“详细的”通常用terperinci。定义据[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=perincian)整理；词族见[rinci](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rinci)。

senses.zh_definition: 对计划、事项或要求所作的详细说明；具体细节。
senses.en_definition: A detailed account or specification of a plan, matter, or requirement.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian sesuatu perkara yang merangkumi aspek dan butirnya secara lengkap.
senses.nuances: 强调说明的具体内容，未必涉及数字分项。可说memberikan perincian；不要把perincian直接当作形容词修饰laporan。见[DBP词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=perincian)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Sila kemukakan perincian kos projek sebelum permohonan peruntukan dipertimbangkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请先提交项目成本明细，以便审议拨款申请。
dual_scenarios.en: Please submit a breakdown of the project costs before the funding application is considered.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah hantar perincian kos kat aku ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah menghantar perincian kos kepada saya?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你把费用明细发给我了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you sent me the cost breakdown yet?
spoken_features: kat aku在此对应kepada saya，表示接收者。
句末ke构成口语是非问句。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records perincian within the rinci word family, whose meanings include dividing something into small parts and explaining it point by point. The noun preserves both ideas: an itemised breakdown and a detailed account. Its financial and administrative uses therefore share a practical image—opening a broad statement into individually visible particulars. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rinci).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把perincian想成“把总账拆成一行行”：rinci抓住逐项细说，perincian就是列出的明细。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 索取明细可说Boleh berikan perincian kos?；对上级或客户可用Mohon pihak tuan/puan memberikan perincian，语气更正式。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于报价、预算、项目计划及说明文件。请求时讲明需要哪些项目；涉及工资、个人账目等资料时，通过合适的私人或工作渠道沟通。
